evidence.quote: In light of the relatively muted recoveries to date in the advanced economies, the central banks of those economies have generally continued accommodative monetary policies.
These capital flows reflect in part the continued two-speed nature of the global recovery, as economic growth in the emerging markets is far outstripping growth in the advanced economies.
emerging market economies have a strong interest in a continued economic recovery in the advanced economies, which accommodative monetary policies in the advanced economies are intended to promote.
Our collective challenge is to reshape the international monetary system to foster strong, sustainable growth and improve economic outcomes for all nations.

parsed.rationale: The speech focuses mainly on international capital flows and the global saving glut, but it defends continued accommodative policy in advanced economies by pointing to muted recoveries. That gives a mild dovish lean, though there is little direct signal about the future path of US policy.
